content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the RGU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download RGU Teaching Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.A/M.Sc in Psychology with minimum 55% marks (or equivalent) from accredited Indian or foreign University. Must have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar test like SLET/SET. PhD awardees exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Desirable: Ph.D degree and teaching experience preferred.

content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Consolidated salary: Rs. 1,000/- per class to maximum of Rs. 40,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the RGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Rajiv Gandhi University recruitment is Teaching Assistant. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Teaching Assistant post at Rajiv Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 21 August 2026. Candidates should attend on this date.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.A/M.Sc in Psychology with a minimum of 55% marks and must have cleared NET/SLET/SET or be PhD exempted.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Teaching Assistant position?
faq.answer: The salary is consolidated, ranging from Rs. 1,000/- per class to a maximum of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the RGU Teaching Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the RGU office in Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh, with the pincode 791112.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.
